text.aria-label: Title text 'Only the output offset beats the coarse M0 at the eight MVA Primaries; no design beats it at the six MW Primaries Dot: estimate (2 seeds; D5: 5 seeds twice). Line: 95% interval, Bonferroni, from resampling whole months. Dashed line: same as coarse M0. 24-120 h leads. Placebos permute months (4) or use old summaries (2).'
text.tspan: Only the output offset beats the coarse M0 at the eight MVA Primaries; no design beats it at the six MW Primaries
Dot: estimate (2 seeds; D5: 5 seeds twice). Line: 95% interval, Bonferroni, from resampling whole months.
Dashed line: same as coarse M0. 24-120 h leads. Placebos permute months (4) or use old summaries (2).
